answer: Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so replaying an old answer dies at the first check. Reviewers stake behind each pass and a random spot audit re-runs the claimed work; a review that fails to reproduce is slashed and the pass voided. Because each verdict is recorded as another shale layer of stake and nonce, the echo of a failed audit follows that identity to every later panel on the horizon. The cost is a standing retainer of independent reviewers, and one upheld audit erases the batch margin.
